chunk.content: Scomberomorus commerson, one candidate species within the ambiguous tenggiri label, is marketed mainly fresh and also dried-salted, frozen, smoked, and canned.
chunk.source_quote: Marketed mainly fresh and also dried-salted, frozen, smoked and canned.
